description: This file defines logging utilities and configurations for the OpenClaw project, including log level management, label parsing, log handler implementations for system and file logging, and integration with Swift's Logging API.

classes.name: OpenClawOSLogHandler
classes.description: A log handler that sends logs to the system OS log with support for different log levels and metadata merging.

classes.name: OpenClawFileLogHandler
classes.description: A log handler that writes logs to a file, conditionally enabled via user settings, with support for metadata inclusion.

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level from user defaults.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the current log level in user defaults.

methods.name: fileLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if file logging is enabled based on user defaults.

methods.name: makeLabel
methods.description: Constructs a label string from subsystem and category for logging purposes.

methods.name: parseLabel
methods.description: Parses a label string into subsystem and category components.

methods.name: bootstrapIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs logging system bootstrap if it hasn't been initialized.
